translations.literal: His son, Prince Min Huwei, succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: He was succeeded by his son, Prince Min Huwei.

translations.zh: 永初元年，太后封宋衍為盛鄉侯，分清河為二國，封慶少子常保為廣川王，子女十一人皆為鄉公主，食邑奉。
translations.literal: In the first year of Yongchu, the empress dowager enfeoffed Song Yan as marquis of Shengxiang, divided Qinghe into two states, enfeoffed Qing's youngest son Changbao as Prince of Guangchuan; eleven sons and daughters were all made village princesses with fiefs for support.
translations.idiomatic: In 107 CE, the first year of Yongchu, Empress Dowager Deng enfeoffed Song Yan as Marquis of Shengxiang, split Qinghe into two principalities, and made Liu Qing's youngest son Changbao Prince of Guangchuan; all eleven of his sons and daughters were made village princesses with sustaining fiefs.

translations.literal: The next year Changbao died; he had no son; the state was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The next year Changbao died without an heir, and the fief was abolished.
